user.title: Connect to Proxmox VE
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Proxmox VE server.

data_description.user: Username without realm, for example root
data_description.realm: pam for local users, pve for Proxmox VE users
data_description.timeout: Seconds to wait for a reply from Proxmox before an update counts as failed. Raise it for remote or heavily loaded hosts.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Proxmox VE
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials were rejected. Enter them again.

resources.title: Select resources

data_description.auto_add: When on, VMs, containers, nodes and storages created in Proxmox later are added on their own. Items you deselect above stay excluded.
data_description.include_templates: VM and container templates never run and report no usage, so their sensors stay empty. Off by default.

resources.description: Found {nodes} nodes, {qemu} VMs, {lxc} containers and {storage} storages. Only the selected resources are polled.

behaviour.title: Polling and cleanup

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. Proxmox does not push data, so this determines how current the values are. Below 10 seconds mostly adds load.
data_description.grace_period: Days a VM, container, node or storage may stay missing from Proxmox before its device and entities are deleted. This keeps history through migrations, restores and maintenance. Set to 0 to delete right away.
data_description.enable_controls: Start, stop and reboot buttons for VMs and containers. These need the VM.PowerMgmt permission. Turn off for a read-only token.
data_description.node_details: Adds load average, IO wait, swap, root filesystem and kernel version. Costs one extra API call per node and cycle. Turn off on large clusters.
data_description.task_window: Hours the failed task sensor looks back.

behaviour.description: How often Proxmox is queried and what happens to resources that disappear.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Proxmox server. Check host, port and SSL setting.
error.invalid_auth: Credentials rejected. Check username, realm and token or password.
error.missing_token: Token ID and token secret are both required.

abort.already_configured: This Proxmox server is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Proxmox server.
